# CircleSeeker local test fixtures

Generated by `generate_testdata.py` from YaoxinBio/CircleSeeker **v1.6.1**
`tests/simulation/eccdna_simulator.py`, with tandem-copy CI adaptation.

Same recipe as `nf-core/modules` `modules/nf-core/circleseeker/tests/generate_testdata.py`.

```bash
python testdata/generate_testdata.py \
  --circle-seeker-src /path/to/CircleSeeker \
  --out /tmp/cs_out
# then copy circleseeker_test_reads.fa → test_reads.fa
#           circleseeker_test_ref.fa   → test_ref.fa
```
